title: One Piece (ワンピース)
author: Oda Eiichiro
description: Monkey D. Luffy, a boy whose body gained the properties of rubber after eating a Devil Fruit, explores the Grand Line with his diverse crew of pirates in search of the treasure known as 'One Piece' to become the next Pirate King.

title: Attack on Titan (Shingeki no Kyojin)
author: Isayama Hajime
description: After his hometown is destroyed and his mother is killed, young Eren Jaeger vows to cleanse the earth of the giant humanoid Titans that have brought humanity to the brink of extinction.

title: Attack on Titan: Junior High
author: Isayama Hajime
description: A comedic reimagining of Attack on Titan where Eren and the characters attend Titan Junior High School.

title: Attack on Titan: Before the Fall
author: Suzukaze Ryo
description: Prequel to the main series depicting humanity discovering how to develop the Omni-directional mobility gear.

title: Jujutsu Kaisen
author: Akutami Gege
description: Yuji Itadori swallows a cursed talisman - the finger of a demon - and becomes cursed himself. He enters a shaman's school to locate the demon's other body parts.

title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba
author: Gotouge Koyoharu
description: Tanjiro Kamado sets out on a perilous quest to avenge his slaughtered family and cure his sister Nezuko, who has been turned into a demon.

title: Death Note
author: Ohba Tsugumi
description: A high school prodigy discovers a supernatural notebook that grants him the ability to kill anyone by writing their name, and embarks on a crusade against criminals.

title: Fullmetal Alchemist
author: Arakawa Hiromu
description: Two brothers search for a Philosopher's Stone after an attempt to revive their deceased mother goes wrong and leaves them physically damaged.

title: Naruto
author: Kishimoto Masashi
description: Naruto Uzumaki, a mischievous adolescent ninja, struggles for recognition and dreams of becoming the Hokage, the village's leader and strongest ninja.

title: Bleach
author: Kubo Tite
description: Ichigo Kurosaki gains the abilities of a Soul Reaper and takes on the duty of protecting humans from evil spirits and guiding souls to the afterlife.

title: Chainsaw Man
author: Fujimoto Tatsuki
description: Denji is a teenage boy living with a Chainsaw Devil named Pochita. After a betrayal, he is reborn as the dangerous devil hunter Chainsaw Man.

title: My Hero Academia
author: Horikoshi Kohei
description: In a world where people with superpowers known as 'Quirks' are the norm, Izuku Midoriya dreams of becoming a Hero despite being born without powers.

title: Hunter x Hunter
author: Togashi Yoshihiro
description: Gon Freecss discovers that his presumed-dead father is an elite Hunter. Gon embarks on a journey to take the Hunter Exam and find him.

title: Berserk
author: Miura Kentaro
description: Guts, a solitary mercenary known as the Black Swordsman, seeks sanctuary from malevolent demonic forces pursuing him and revenge against his former comrade Griffith.

title: Vinland Saga
author: Yukimura Makoto
description: Thorfinn pursues a journey of vengeance against his father's killer, eventually transforming into a seeker of true peace and the legendary land of Vinland.

title: Monster
author: Urasawa Naoki
description: Dr. Kenzo Tenma, an elite brain surgeon in Germany, risks his prestige to save the life of an injured boy, only to discover years later that the boy has grown into a charismatic monster.

title: Vagabond
author: Inoue Takehiko
description: Shinmen Takezo transitions from a wild outcast into Miyamoto Musashi, exploring the true essence of swordplay and spiritual enlightenment in 16th-century Japan.

title: Tokyo Ghoul
author: Ishida Sui
description: After barely surviving a deadly encounter with a flesh-eating ghoul, Ken Kaneki undergoes surgery that transforms him into a half-ghoul.

title: One Punch Man
author: ONE
description: Saitama has become so unimaginably powerful that he defeats any enemy with a single punch, leading to an existential crisis of boredom.

title: Fruits Basket
author: Takaya Natsuki
description: After losing her mother, cheerful orphan Tohru Honda discovers the secret curse of the Sohma family, whose members turn into animals of the Chinese Zodiac when hugged by the opposite sex.

title: Sailor Moon
author: Takeuchi Naoko
description: Usagi Tsukino discovers a talking cat named Luna who reveals that Usagi is Sailor Moon, destiny-bound protector of Earth and seeker of the Silver Crystal.

title: Kimi ni Todoke: From Me to You
author: Shiina Karuho
description: Sawako Kuronuma is nicknamed 'Sadako' due to her scary appearance, but her life changes when the warm, popular boy Kazehaya begins talking to her.

title: Ouran High School Host Club
author: Hatori Bisco
description: Haruhi Fujioka stumbles upon the eccentric Ouran Academy Host Club and accidentally breaks an expensive vase, forcing her to work as a male host to repay the debt.

title: NANA
author: Yazawa Ai
description: Two girls with the same name, Nana Komatsu and punk rock singer Nana Osaki, meet on a train to Tokyo and decide to become roommates as they chase their dreams and heartbreaks.

title: Wotakoi: Love Is Hard for Otaku
author: Fujita
description: A closet fujoshi and an intense gaming otaku begin dating as colleagues at work, navigating adult office romance with their nerdy hobbies.

title: Chihayafuru
author: Suetsugu Yuki
description: Chihaya Ayase falls in love with the competitive Japanese poetry card game Karuta and aims to become the Queen of Japan alongside her childhood friends.

title: Kaguya-sama: Love Is War
author: Akasaka Aka
description: Two prideful student council geniuses view love as a battlefield and scheme endlessly to make the other confess their feelings first.

title: Spy x Family
author: Endo Tatsuya
description: A master spy creates a fake family for a mission, unaware that his adopted daughter is a telepath and his fake wife is a skilled assassin.

title: Horimiya
author: HERO
description: A capable popular girl and a gloomy pierced otaku secretly share their real personalities outside of school, forming a sweet bond.

title: Grand Blue Dreaming
author: Inoue Kenji
description: Iori Kitahara begins college life at a coastal university, joining an eccentric scuba diving club characterized by wild parties and alcohol.

title: Haikyu!!
author: Furudate Haruichi
description: Determined to be like the volleyball star 'Little Giant', the short Shoyo Hinata revives the volleyball club at Karasuno High School.

title: Slam Dunk
author: Inoue Takehiko
description: Delinquent Hanamichi Sakuragi joins the Shohoku High School basketball team to impress a girl, discovering an unexpected passion for the sport.

title: Solanin
author: Asano Inio
description: Meiko and Taneda are young college grads facing the anxiety and disillusionment of early adulthood in Tokyo.

title: Kaichou wa Maid-sama!
author: Fujiwara Hiro
description: Misaki Ayuzawa, the strict first female student council president at a former all-boys school, secretly works at a maid cafe to support her family.

title: Nodame Cantabile
author: Ninomiya Tomoko
description: Shinichi Chiaki, an ambitious classical music perfectionist, crosses paths with Megumi Noda, an eccentric and talented pianist nicknamed Nodame.
